Unsupported, mismatched or failed target selection closes the owned socket without target fallback
Other target addresses retain the original connection function; no global route, VPN, adapter or credential configuration is changed
Each successful cell requires a positive number of target hooks and all attempts to have verified interface settings and connections
The first failed cell stops later dispatch, existing result namespaces are refused, and original default-route failure evidence remains unchanged
Original credential handling and six instrument/corpus pins remain intact
Network selection is an explicit measurement factor and causal software speedup is false
